backlog.spec: Update DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 256. If OOM, dynamically reduce to next power of 2 down to 32 on next iteration. Increase total tokens processed per step to exploit the large A100 showing diminishing val_bpb hits at 40G.
backlog.title: Adaptive Global Batch Size

backlog.spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO=0.0 with WARMUP_STEPS becalculated from time_budget so that warmup covers 0-10% of steps, then slope rises to MATRIX_LR over 2000 more steps. This often stabilizes early gradient flows.
backlog.title: Linear Warmup Schedule

backlog.spec: Introduce LRSCHEDULES variable mapping layer index to a ratio of MATRIX_LR. Layers 0-4 use 0.4*LR, layers 5-8 use 0.8*LR. Applies a gentle LR drop to early layers to reduce noise propagation.
backlog.title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Sweep

backlog.spec: Increase DEPTH to 12 while keeping ASPECT_RATIO at 64; this changes model_dim to 768, raising compute density but also additive regularization from wider heads, reducing jitter.
backlog.title: Arch Scale-RF

backlog.spec: Add a loss component: weighted sum of per-tensor, 2.5LF frequency voting losses for each layer, scaled by 7.1e-5, added over last 800s to smooth final summary convergence.
backlog.title: Wavenumber Voting

backlog.spec: Replace residual connection with a 'q-residual' that mixes 30% of input before summing with prev output. This reduces pathological residual gradients in the first few epochs.
backlog.title: Quasi-Residual Mixing

backlog.spec: Switch to a clock-based LR schedule: start at MATRIX_LR and decay to 10% of that over 60 seconds, then stay flat until 30s before final 10s with a steep linear sink to 0.01 of MATRIX_LR. This avoids entropy-based scheduling noise.
backlog.title: Clock-Locked LR

backlog.spec: Add a bias=0.024 constant to the softmax logits for input encoding. This slightly shifts the logits distribution toward high-frequency features, often stabilizing token predictions.
backlog.title: GEP Softmax Bias

backlog.spec: Replace simple batch loop with a micro-batch 8 of 8 split; deepens unrolled loop overhead and can reduce gradient variance by 3.2%. Use 256 as the GRAND BATCH SIZE.
backlog.title: Micro-Batch Spec

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.08 and add a separate regularization term for per-layer scalars that decays 1e-4 times faster than matrix regularization; this reduces gradient noise.
backlog.title: Optimal Reg

backlog.spec: Add a 'deep_mix' block that inserts a 4-layer transformer between input and residual for first 200s. This increases effective depth locally to smooth gradient flow.
backlog.title: DeepMix Sensitivity

backlog.spec: Add a wavenumber decay factor 0.99 to gradients computed for layers 3-8 only, applied each global step, to dampen high-frequency noise in deeper layers.
backlog.title: Wavenumber Decay

backlog.spec: Divide TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE training steps by a divisor-of-2^19, p=1 as a starting point; this allows dynamic scheduling of batches to fit wall-clock time.
backlog.title: Optimal Epoch Divisor

backlog.spec: Add a clamp to the activation function (e.g., ReLU) for layers 5-8 to reduce overflow to 0.5e-4, which often reduces early overfitting.
backlog.title: Clamp LF

backlog.spec: Replace random token sampling with Q-Q sampling for first 100s of training: sample from a 1.2e-4 distribution, then clamp to [1e-6, 1e-4] for the final 100 steps.
backlog.title: Q-Q Sampling

backlog.spec: Admiring LR schedule: start at 0.01*MATRIX_LR for first 100s, then increase to 0.4*MATRIX_LR over next 500s, then decay to 0.02*MATRIX_LR at 90s.
backlog.title: Admiring LR

backlog.spec: Replace 1.0+residual with 1.3+residual; this modifies the linear combination to be 1.3 * prev_output + input, which can smooth gradient flow by 2.1%.
backlog.title: Residual Mixing 3

backlog.spec: Add lambda constraints to the loss: a small penalty on the sum of squared activations for the first three layers, scaled by 4.1e-6.
backlog.title: Lambda Constraints

backlog.spec: Add a stop-loss mechanism: if validation loss over 200s exceeds 1.0, halt training and restart the epoch without a penalty.
backlog.title: Stop Loss

backlog.spec: Apply a wavenumber learning rate to each layer: 0.85 * MATRIX_LR for odd layers and 0.95 * MATRIX_LR for even layers. reduces noise propagation.
backlog.title: Wavenumber LR

backlog.spec: Compute a grand batch modulo 2^19, dividing the batch into 2^19 of 2^19; this ensures a balanced distribution of gradients across the GPU memory.
backlog.title: Grand Batch Modulo

backlog.spec: Add a hypothesis validation step: every 500 steps, validate on a small subset of the validation set to detect early signs of overfitting.
backlog.title: Hypo-Val

backlog.spec: Add a min-loss term: if the current loss is below 1.0, apply a 4.1e-6 penalty to prevent early overfitting.
backlog.title: Min Loss

backlog.spec: Insert a stochastic depth gate: with probability 0.2, skip the residual connection for the first 200s. This can smooth the gradient flow.
backlog.title: Stochastic Depth

backlog.spec: Introduce a small 'hyper-kernel' (a few 1x1 conv layers after embedding but before layers) that, conditioned on the layer index, scales the residual mixing coefficients for that layer, allowing data-driven hyperparameter tuning per layer without changing the base architecture.
backlog.title: HyperNetwork Weight Scaling

backlog.spec: Replace the static warmup/schedule with a lightweight logistic-sigmoid function of global step that acts as the single 'learning rate' applied to all optimizer groups, allowing the entire model to ramp down together in a smoother, non-linear decay curve.
backlog.title: Adaptive Time-Dependent LR

backlog.spec: Add a detach cross-attention module that runs on a separate 'content' embedding stream (size 128) which is keyed to the current layer index and censored to produce an injected auxiliary input to the residual stream, free from the main loss contribution.
backlog.title: Cross-Attention Feature Injection

backlog.spec: Apply a non-linear soft-thresholding (ReLU-style) winnowing mechanism to the residual stream's coefficients before mixing, as opposed to simple passing, to suppress vanishingly small activations that contribute little to the loss gradient.
backlog.title: Optimal Regen Winnow

backlog.spec: Instead of a global scalar residual mixing step, implement a 2x2 block matrix residual mixing where adjacent layers' contributions are combined using a learned mixing kernel from a small auxiliary block, based on layer indices.
backlog.title: Hierarchical Gradient Mixing

backlog.spec: Replace standard dropout with a dropout mask that varies with the global sequence position within a batch (sinusoird mask) so that different sequence positions see different dropout patterns, promoting frequency-domain smoothing.
backlog.title: Differential Dropout

backlog.spec: Introduce a small prior network that estimates weight priors for the matrix and scalar groups based on global time, allowing the optimizer to dynamically adjust the regularization strength on the fly depending on the training epoch.
backlog.title: Multi-Scale Weight Prior

backlog.spec: Apply a small Fourier-domain decay to the cross-attention feature maps specifically targeting high-frequency components relative to the layer index, effectively low-pass filtering the residual stream to smooth out spectral noise.
backlog.title: Wavenumber Decay

backlog.spec: Instead of micro-batching on sequence, perform a micro-batch spec where an additional 'spec' stream of size matching half the batch dimension is used, and a small per-layer prior is projected into this spec stream to modulate the attention weights.
backlog.title: Micro-Batch Spec

backlog.spec: Introduce a separate 'hypo-val' stream that is processed independently and whose output is injected into the residual stream at a rate proportional to the global step, enabling the model to 'hallucinate' and refine predictions on-the-fly without affecting the main loss.
backlog.title: Hypo-Val Injection

backlog.spec: Introduce a spectral batch norm variant where the global mean/variance is computed separately for low-frequency (positions < ASPECT_RATIO/2) and high-frequency components (embeddings) of the normalization parameters. Tune these independently to stabilize training across spatial and feature domains simultaneously.
backlog.title: Spectral Frequency Adaptation

backlog.spec: During backprop, add a small, orthogonal ripple to the residual gradients before它们在 the hidden layer, scaled by ARCH_SCALE_FACTOR * (local_grad_norm / global_grad_norm)^0.2. This injects high-frequency information into the gradient path without altering direction.
backlog.title: Gradient-Orientation Ripple Injection

backlog.spec: Before applying the attention mechanism, replace each position's query vector with a weighted combination of its left and right context tokens' queries, using a ratio that decays exponentially with distance. This allows the model to learn attention patterns over spatial neighborhoods rather than single positions.
backlog.title: Temporal Order Mixing

backlog.spec: Replace the global LR schedule with a layer-specific warmup where layers 0-3 receive 1.2x the initial LR, and layers 4+ receive 0.8x the initial LR, scaled to the official WARMUP_RATIO in steps. This accelerates early learning while stabilizing deeper layers.
backlog.title: Layer-Dependent Weight Warmup

backlog.spec: Apply a soft-shrinkage (soft threshold) to the residual stream before it is added to the inputs, using a lambda that scales with the layer depth. This forces residuals of small magnitude to zero, effectively performing aggressive pruning on each layer.
backlog.title: Residual Stream Compression

backlog.spec: Split the global batch into micro-batches of size 8. Process each micro-batch independently, compute the loss, and accumulate gradients. At the end of the batch cycle, synchronize the accumulated gradients to the model. This decouples the optimizer step count from the wall-clock batch size.
backlog.title: Micro-Batch Gradient Accumulation

backlog.spec: Insert a small cross-attention block between the residual and x0 components of each transformer layer. This block uses the residual as the query and the x0 component as the key/value. The output is fused back into the residual stream, allowing the model to dynamically learn correlations between its own outputs and internal parameters.
backlog.title: Cross-Attention Feature Fusion

backlog.spec: Implement stochastic depth where entire blocks are skipped with probability 0.1 for the first 100 steps and decay to 0.2 for later steps. Additionally, apply a depthwise dropout to the output of each block before it is fused into the residual stream, randomizing the effective depth of each layer.
backlog.title: Stochastic Depth with Depthwise Dropout

backlog.spec: Add a regularization term to the loss that penalizes the difference between the weight distribution of each layer and a Gaussian distribution. The penalty is scaled by the layer index, forcing early layers to be more regularized while allowing later layers to vary more freely.
backlog.title: Layer-wise Regularization

backlog.spec: During backprop, reorder the gradients by magnitude and reshape them into a form that allows the gradient to propagate in a more stable manner. This involves sorting the gradients and shifting them to be applied in a specific order across the layers.
backlog.title: Gradient Reordering
